records.text: Claire Guinan's first Jezebel article reported paying Etsy witches to curse Charlie Kirk less than ten days after Kirk's White House debate against pro-Netanyahu lobbyists.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: This writer, Claire Guinan, who had never published before—she has no writing profile at all—writes her first article for Jezebel. ... She starts in June. Claire Guinan, no interest in the press about figuring out what inspired her to go on to Etsy and find ... a new witch profile and buy a spell about harming Charlie Kirk, putting a curse onto Charlie Kirk. ... It's very unusual. We paid some Etsy witches to curse Charlie Kirk. That was just less than 10 days after Charlie (Charlie Kirk) won this debate against Bibi (Benjamin Netanyahu)'s many lobbyists.

verification.notes: The Jezebel article about hiring Etsy witches to curse Charlie Kirk was published on September 8, 2025, not within ten days of the June 18 debate. Reporting also identifies Claire Guinan as the article’s original byline; the timing portion is false.

sources.title: Jezebel Adds Editor’s Note to Charlie Kirk Witch Article
sources.relevance: Dates the witch article to September 8, 2025, directly refuting the claimed late-June timing.
